'''Pokémon TV Animation Comic - I Choose You!''' is a comic book published as a collaboration between [[VIZ Media]] and [[Nintendo Power]]. It is a bound collection of all of the "{{OBP|Pokémon Power|magazine}}" Ani-Manga comics that appeared in Nintendo Power magazine, which in turn are translations of the [[Pocket Monsters Film Comic]]s created in Japan.

Pokémon TV Animation Comic - I Choose You! contains adaptations of ''[[EP001|Pokémon - I Choose You!]]'' through ''[[EP006|Clefairy and the Moon Stone]]'', as well as character biographies and [[Pokédex entry|Pokédex entries]] for some of the Pokémon that appeared in those stories.
